states require complete finite decimal numbers, while zero remains valid
number metadata rejects malformed bounds/steps and out-of-range reports

availability conditions distinguish known disabled from unknown state
sample timestamps require timezone and valid calendar/time fields
freshness requires explicit sample time and expires at the configured deadline

source, availability, freshness and history settings validate known fields
release notes select an exact version, not adjacent entries
missing or empty notes block publication
the four water-care presets have finite ordered scales
piecewise interpolation agrees at each segment midpoint
extreme finite readings clamp to the ends instead of escaping the card

trend contracts reject malformed sources, units, precision and thresholds without mutating YAML

derivative freshness and availability use explicit contracts, never HA transport age
trend text does not round tiny changes into a directed zero or call a deadband proof of stability
